userStories.title: Validation engine — all 10 business rules
userStories.description: Implement ReportValidationService with ALL validation rules from SPEC Section 11: required fields, date validation (current/previous months, future if enabled, rest day check), monthly row limit, daily 9-hour limit (unless unlimited), annual row limit, duplicate row detection (same date + same values + empty/identical notes), submission deadline, notes similarity percentage check (configurable threshold).
acceptanceCriteria: Rule 1: All required fields must be filled
Rule 2: Dates in current or previous months; future only if AllowFutureReporting on employee AND month
Rule 3: Cannot exceed monthly row allocation
Rule 4: Cannot exceed 9 daily hours unless 'Unlimited' set for employee
Rule 5: Cannot exceed annual row allocation
Rule 6: Duplicate = same date + same values + empty Notes → blocked
Rule 7: Duplicate = same date + same values + identical Notes → blocked
Rule 8: Cannot submit after ReportingMonth.LastReportingDate
Rule 9: Cannot report on employee's Rest Day
Rule 10: Notes similarity check uses normalized Levenshtein similarity within the same report: (1 - editDistance / maxLength) * 100; threshold comes from SystemConstants
Monthly hours validated against MonthlyEmploymentScope (warn if under, don't block)
All rules run for both online form and Excel import
Clear Hebrew error messages for each validation failure
Unit tests for all 10 rules with edge cases
